_comment: Vendor bundles for the rendered-UI harness, COMMITTED so the harness needs no npm install beyond playwright. These MUST match the CDN versions dashboard.html pins, or the harness tests the client against a different Chart.js than production ships. tests/unit/ui-harness-vendor.test.js enforces that. F-11: sha256 ties the manifest to the BUNDLE BYTES -- when you re-copy a bundle for a version bump, update its hash from the test's failure message (or sha256sum).
